scope: Bounded audit of six compound props for unmistakable missing functional forms or containers still represented as closed primitives. Excludes micro-wear, texture richness, proportion tuning and new design proposals.

entries.finding: Three actual slatted shelves, supports and open spaces are present. No solid-box or missing-shelf functional omission. Relative depth/proportions and wear differences excluded.

Slatted work surface, four legs and lower/upper braces are present. Concept includes a vice which the isolated bench sheet excludes, but production hideout._build_workshop calls _build_rusty_vice at the tabletop, and rusty_vice has its own catalog entry. This is catalog separation, not a missing production vice.

Mattress, separate pillow/blanket, raised wood frame, underside slats and straw fringe exist. The mattress and textile volume are not a bare cuboid. No essential functional component omission; fine straw/fold differences excluded.
Broken head/arm silhouette, carved robe folds, pedestal and cross are present. No identity-defining missing component beyond the deliberate head/limb damage; sculptural detail differences excluded.

Clearly open pot rim, visible stew/ingredients, curved bowl, side handles and closed bottom are present. It is not a capped primitive. Extra camp supports/spoon are actual production components; texture/detail differences excluded.

Separate arched lid, body, reinforcing straps/rivets and front locking plate are present. Reference depicts a closed chest, so an open interior is not required by these six views. No clear functional omission.
